title: Find Smallest Common Element in All Rows
summary: In an m x n matrix where each row is sorted in ascending order, identify the smallest element present in every row.
statement: In an m x n matrix where each row is sorted in ascending order, identify the smallest element present in every row. If no such element exists, return -1.
constraints: Return -1 when the row intersection is empty.
hints: Start with the set of values in the first row.
Intersect it with each subsequent row’s values.
Return the minimum remaining value, or -1 if none remains.
Set intersection preserves exactly values appearing in every processed row.
editorial: Set intersection preserves exactly values appearing in every processed row.

tests.explanation: Five is the smallest value shared by all four rows.
The rows have no common value.
